title: Veronese Avoiding Hypersurfaces
summary: We introduce Veronese-Avoiding hypersurfaces, inspired by the theory of associated forms of Alper--Isaev. In the smooth case, we reinterpret their criterion via Macaulay inverse systems: the Veronese-Avoiding condition is equivalent to the non-degeneracy of the associated form. In the singular case, our main theorem shows that a reduced hypersurface with exactly $n$ isolated singular points is Veronese-Avoiding if and only if these points are ordinary nodes in general linear position; we also classify singular plane cubics and treat fewer than $n$ nodes via a natural rational map.
